votes.quote: for absolute paths, the spec says a marker only counts if it isn't the last segment. At `src/normalizeProjectName.ts:7` the check is `index <= parts.length - 1`. That's true for any marker that exists at all, so a marker in the last position still counts. Nothing comes after it, so the function returns an empty string
